info.title: HPE Aruba Networking EdgeConnect SD-WAN
info.description:
HPE Aruba Networking EdgeConnect SD-WAN Orchestrator centrally manages EdgeConnect appliances, Business Intent Overlays, and tunnels across a WAN fabric.

Authentication: static API key in the X-Auth-Token header.

servers.description: HPE Aruba Networking EdgeConnect SD-WAN Orchestrator server. This platform does not apply OpenAPI server variables/paths automatically — set the integration instance's server.base_path to "/gms/rest".
